commit_sha_note: Source files were reviewed at main; observed_main_sha_at_delivery was subsequently retrieved from GitHub API. The source-reading requests were not independently pinned to this SHA.

renderer.media: WebM video with alpha for transparent presentation
renderer.display: A/B HTMLVideoElement playback drawn into a 2D Canvas; audio muted

component_exposed_methods.playAnimation: async (name: string, loop = false, turn = false); name must resolve to a manifest-listed WebM
component_exposed_methods.retry: Reset stage and restart sleep or idle animation
component_exposed_methods.endDrag: End active pointer drag and resume animation selection

animation_buckets.idle: Required nonempty array of animation names
animation_buckets.turn: Required array; may be empty; direction changes after a selected turn clip finishes
animation_buckets.drag: Required array; may be empty; selected clip loops during dragging
animation_buckets.clicks: Required array; may be empty; selected clip plays on activation
animation_buckets.categories: Required array of {id, weight, actions, noMirror?}; actions must be nonempty
animation_buckets.sleep: Optional array of matched {start, loop, end} nonempty name arrays
animation_buckets.events: Optional record whose values are arrays of animation names or nonempty name arrays
animation_buckets.moves: Optional {default: numeric record, actions: [{name, params?: numeric record}]}; walking clips are available for explicit playback, not automatic roaming
animation_buckets.baifan: Optional animation name array; accepted metadata does not establish an active desktop behavior

status_selection.category_selection: Positive weights only; noMirror categories excluded when facing right
status_selection.repeat_policy: Avoid current clip when a pool has alternatives

emotion_files_hardcoded_in_component.sad: 工作状态-垂头叹气冒汗.webm
emotion_files_hardcoded_in_component.question: 工作状态-原地踱步张望.webm

emotion_notes: Mapped feedback is skipped when its filename is absent from pack.files.
Emotion watcher is suppressed while sleeping, speaking, thinking or dragging.
The strict manifest schema has no emotionMap field. Preserve these filenames to reuse current emotion feedback without code changes.

files.forbidden_characters: backslash, percent, colon, question mark, hash, U+0000 through U+001F
files.path_components: Nonempty; no . or ..; maximum 255 characters each

manifest_contract.runtime_only_field: baseUrl is added after validation; do not put it in an import manifest

native_import_limits.imported_id: Generated UUID v4 replaces manifest id

asset_production_implications: Deliver each class as its own visual variant, preserving character identity and compatible action names.
Static PNG concept previews are source/reference assets, not a runnable animation pack.
A future importable pack needs actual transparent WebM clips plus a valid manifest and playback verification.
Keep framing, character scale and baseline consistent across clips to reduce jumps at A/B transitions.
Retain applicable source asset license and provenance separately from the strict manifest.
